jobs.title: Supplier Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity


As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will own supplier quality for a portfolio of critical mechanical, electrical and mechatronic suppliers, from supplier qualification through production and continuous improvement.

The role exists to strengthen our supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales production and introduces new products. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, and will spend time directly with suppliers to solve quality issues at the source.

This is a hands-on role: you will not only define processes and requirements, but also audit suppliers, drive corrective actions and make sure improvements are implemented and sustained.


Your Impact

Your Impact

  • Define supplier qualification criteria and establish robust processes for assessing and approving new suppliers.

  • Prepare and maintain supplier audit and assessment frameworks, including questionnaires and checklists.

  • Conduct on-site assessments of critical suppliers and drive audit findings through to closure.

  • Monitor supplier performance, identify recurring quality issues and initiate improvement or development actions where needed.

  • Identify suppliers, manufacturers and service providers requiring Quality Assurance Agreements (QAAs).

  • Develop and maintain QAA templates aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO 80079-34 requirements.

  • Review and negotiate QAA terms with suppliers, covering responsibilities, control points, traceability, non-conformities and other quality requirements.

  • Coordinate internal Quality, Legal and Purchasing approvals for QAAs and monitor ongoing supplier compliance.

  • Define and maintain the supplier NCR process, from detection and reporting through escalation, follow-up and closure.

  • Establish effective NCR templates and tracking tools, and communicate non-conformities clearly with suppliers.

  • Analyse NCR trends and recurring issues to identify systemic quality problems and drive corrective actions.

  • Initiate supplier development, improvement plans or requalification where supplier performance falls below expectations.


Your Profile

  • 5 years  experience in supplier quality management with complex mechatronic product

  • Hands-on experience conducting supplier audits and driving corrective actions through to verified closure.

  • Strong understanding of root-cause analysis, 8D  and structured problem solving.

  • Experience defining and negotiating supplier quality requirements, ideally including Quality Assurance Agreements.

  • Ability to work effectively across Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, while challenging suppliers when quality or delivery requirements are not met.

  • Willingness to travel to suppliers and spend time on-site when required.


Bonus Points
  • Experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 80079-34, particularly in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience building or improving supplier quality processes in a scaling manufacturing organization.
  • Familiarity with statistical quality tools such as SPC, Cpk/Ppk and Pareto analysis.

    • What We Offer

    • The opportunity to own supplier quality for a portfolio of components directly contributing to the production of autonomous mobile robots.

    • Direct collaboration with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams in Zurich and with suppliers internationally.

    • The opportunity to build and improve supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales its production and product portfolio.

    We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.
     
     
    Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
What we do

At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.

Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.

Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.

After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.

If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.


What you'll be doing

You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
  • Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
  • Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
  • Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it

Turn the data into something users act on

  • Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
  • Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
  • Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway

Own the numbers

  • Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
  • Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
  • Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you


What we are looking for

You might be a fit if:

  • You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
  • You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
  • You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
  • You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
  • Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus
  • You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany

That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have:

  • PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
  • Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
  • Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
  • Subscription and paywall experimentation
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
  • Your own portfolio, and opinions about it

If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like

  • Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
  • Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
  • Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
  • Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you

You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.


Why join getquin?

Why join getquin?

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

  • Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand  and optimize your wealth
  • The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
  • You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours

Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
  2. Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
  3. Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
  4. Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
  5. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder

Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst.

jobs.description:
Introduction

Do you want to do more than just maintain an ERP system—do you want to help shape its future? As a Senior Odoo Engineer for ERP & E-Commerce (all genders), you’ll take responsibility for our Odoo platform—the system that powers sales, order processing, logistics, and accounting.
You’ll further develop our in-house modules, continue the migration to the Odoo standard, integrate new countries, standardize payment processes, and build our new online store—ensuring it’s fully upgradeable, with streamlined workflows and genuine creative freedom.


Your mission

  • The focus is on further developing our Odoo platform—which includes approximately 25 in-house modules—and upgrading it to the target version. In doing so, you’ll rely on an upgrade-friendly architecture based on inheritance rather than modifications to the Odoo core
  • Another key focus of your work will be migrating existing processes to the Odoo standard and integrating new countries—including localization, accounting, and country-specific requirements
  • You’ll ensure seamless and efficient payment processes by integrating PSP connections, SEPA direct debit, and PSD2/SCA, and by managing the interfaces with adjacent systems
  • Together with the relevant stakeholders, you’ll implement our new, mobile-friendly website and online store based on Odoo E-Commerce
  • You ensure code quality and testability, document architecture and design decisions, and provide technical guidance to development partners


Your profile

  • You have several years of experience in Odoo development with Python and have implemented your own modules from requirements through to go-live
  • You have worked with Odoo Enterprise in production environments—including Odoo.sh—for several years and are proficient with Git in professional development and deployment processes
  • For you, Odoo is not just a configuration tool: ORM, inheritance, Views, and QWeb, access rights, and cron jobs are all part of your skill set—ideally complemented by Odoo E-Commerce
  • You confidently analyze existing software, refactor it strategically, and further develop it with a focus on quality, maintainability, and stability
  • Experience with Odoo upgrades, data migrations, multi-company setups, or integrating payment service providers is a definite plus
  • You work in a structured and independent manner, document clearly, and communicate on an equal footing in German and English


Why us?

  • Work Environment & Organization: You enjoy working in our Munich office and value face-to-face interaction with your team. In addition, you can work from home one day a week. You’ll have the freedom to manage your own schedule within the framework of our operational requirements.
  • Workation: Upon agreement, up to 4 weeks of EU workation per year are possible. If you choose Fuerteventura, we’ll also cover your flight, accommodations, and rental car.
  • Freedom & Responsibility: With us, you’ll take on responsibility, actively contribute your ideas, and work in an environment with short decision-making paths and no rigid processes.
  • Modern Office: Look forward to an ergonomic workspace in Munich with a height-adjustable desk, plenty of greenery from plants, an open atmosphere, and short decision-making paths.
  • Attractive Benefits: Monthly deposits to your EmployeeCARD, subsidies for cell phone and internet service, bike leasing, car subscription, retirement savings, and more.
Please note: The application process is coordinated centrally by the ValueNet Group.


Embracing Diversity Together

At ValueNet, we actively promote diversity and equal opportunity. We invite people from all backgrounds to apply—regardless of race, nationality, religion, beliefs, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. Diversity enriches our team and creates space for innovation and shared success.


Values that bring us together

For ValueNet, sustainability is more than just a word—it is an integral part of our actions, our products, and our services. Enthusiasm, trust, courage, and responsibility shape our culture. We are actively committed to fostering an inclusive environment that respects each individual’s uniqueness and strengthens our shared goals.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
jobs.description:
What we do

At Briink, we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials.

Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide.

We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good.

Application requirement: Intro video
As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering:

  1. Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. 
  2. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. 
  3. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you.
Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;)


Your role

As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer, you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals.

This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket.

You will:

  • Own product features end to end, from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement.
  • Design and build scalable backend systems, including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products.
  • Build and ship applied AI/LLM features, such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows
  • Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation.
  • Improve the robustness of our systems, strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale.
  • Work directly with users, product, and data, using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works.
  • Prototype and test new AI capabilities, turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap.
  • Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge, helping the team make better product and technical decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers, including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving.


Your profile

Technical requirements

  • Strong professional backend engineering experience, with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems.
  • Experience in a small, high-ownership product team, ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers.
  • Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end, rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation.
  • Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly).
  • Strong API, database, and systems design skills, with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products.
  • Applied AI/LLM experience: you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems.
  • A solid software-quality mindset, including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security.
  • Cloud and container experience, with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads.
  • Fluent English (C1+), both written and spoken. 
Nice to have
  • Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues 
  • Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks
  • Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems.
  • Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads.
  • Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting.
  • German language skills.
Who you are
  • Kind and collaborative: You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment.
  • Mission-driven: You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action.
  • Sharp and curious: You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems.
  • A product-minded builder: You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value.
  • Highly self-directed: You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight.
  • Pragmatic and action-oriented: You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements.
  • Opinionated but open-minded: You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others.
  • Commercially aware and creative: You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed.

jobs.description:
About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

We are looking for...

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will...

- Own the full sales cycle for a named book of enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signed contract

- Build and run your own pipeline through targeted outbound, events, and partner co-selling with ERP vendors and implementation partners

- Sell to CFOs, VPs of Finance and Heads of FP&A, and bring IT, procurement, security and legal along the way

- Run complex evaluations: discovery, business cases, proofs of concept, and competitive displacements

- Forecast with discipline and keep a clean pipeline in CRM

- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

What we need...

- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals

- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)

- A track record of closing six-figure ARR deals with 3–6 month cycles and hitting or beating quota

- Comfort leading multi-stakeholder deals with finance, IT, procurement and security at the table

- Experience displacing an incumbent, whether a legacy system or a spreadsheet-based process

- A consultative, value-based approach: you build a business case in a CFO's language

- The drive to build your own pipeline, not wait for inbound

- Clear, sharp written and verbal communication, including running demos with senior buyers

- Based in EMEA, with the ability to travel to customers and events

Bonus points if you have...

- Sold with or through ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics) or implementation partners

- Worked in finance, or you're comfortable talking models, drivers and variances with an FP&A team

- Used a structured sales method (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar)

- Been an early seller at a scaling company and helped build the enterprise playbook

Why sell Abacum

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. Abacum is the governed, AI-native foundation that fixes both. That's a displacement story you can tell in every account.

2. AI that stands up to a CFO. Plenty of vendors claim AI. Ours runs on a governed financial model, so the AI reasons and the math stays exact. CFOs and IT teams can trust the output, and that wins technical evaluations.

3. Faster time to value than legacy EPM. 700+ integrations and self-service data pipelines mean customers see value in weeks, not after a long implementation. That shortens your cycle and makes the business case easy to sign.

4. Channels that bring you deals. Abacum is the only FP&A platform to pass NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer Network review, is listed on the Sage Intacct Marketplace, and is a verified Microsoft Dynamics 365 partner. Those ecosystems and our implementation partners mean co-sell pipeline, not just cold outbound.

5. A product that keeps getting stronger. New AI skills ship every week. Abacum works where finance already works: Excel, Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, through MCP-native infrastructure. You'll have something new to show every quarter.

6. Funded to win enterprise. Abacum raised a $60M Series B to scale into larger customers. You'll join as we build the enterprise motion, with the room to shape it and grow with it.

What you get

- Competitive base, uncapped commission, and equity

- Remote in EMEA, with hubs in New York, Toronto and Barcelona

- Direct access to leadership and a real say in how we sell to enterprise

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation including equity package

  • Competitive vacation policy

  • Medical Insurance

  • L&D budget

  • Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

  • Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values

Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.

Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.

Good People: We are self-reflective and praise diversity of thought. We don't justify the end with the means and know where to draw the line. We have fun every day.

Tough Love: We truly care for everyone in the team and embrace honest feedback and radical candor as ways to genuinely help each other.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Our Opportunity

Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.


Your Mission

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver.
You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath.
You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo.
Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties.

Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome


What you'll own

  • Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver.
  • Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact.
  • Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am.
  • Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access.
  • Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable.
  • Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure.
  • Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job.


What success looks like

  • You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use.
  • Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why.
  • You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it.
  • You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you.
  • You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how.


What it takes

  • You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast.
  • You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows.
  • You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy.
  • You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration.
  • You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem.
  • You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers.
  • You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them.
Bonus:

  • AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC.

  • LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows.

  • Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning.

  • Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it.

  • Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard.


Why Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit.

  • Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product.

  • Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create.

  • Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week.

Jetzt geht es um die zweite Stufe: aus einzelnen Kanälen ein System machen, das trägt, und aus marta eine Marke, die Familien kennen, bevor sie zum ersten Mal suchen.

Darauf arbeiten wir gemeinsam hin: die erste große Marke für Altenpflege in Europa. Die gibt es bisher nicht.

Wir suchen die Person, die das plant, koordiniert und schreibt. Du denkst dir Kampagnen aus und bringst sie bis zum fertigen Material. Du entscheidest mit, welchen Kanal wir als Nächstes aufmachen und in welcher Reihenfolge. Und du sprichst mit denen, die das möglich machen: Sendern, Veranstaltern, Partnern, Produktionen.

Wenn du es leid bist, deine beste Idee in einer Präsentation sterben zu sehen, ist das hier der Unterschied: keine Pitch-Runden, keine Freigabekette, keine dritte Feedbackschleife. Du stellst deine Idee dem Performance-Marketing und den Gründern vor, und ihr entscheidet im selben Gespräch. Was montags beschlossen wird, läuft spätestens in der Woche darauf.

Wir sind eine der größten Plattformen im deutschen 24-Stunden-Pflegemarkt, finanziert von führenden Investoren wie Capnamic, Almaz Capital, RTL Ventures und Swiss Health Ventures, mit einem bundesweiten Franchise-System und Teams in Berlin, Bonn, Sibiu und Danzig.

Level: Senior. Du planst und koordinierst: Kanäle, Budget, Timing, Briefings. Die Texte schreibst du selbst.

An deiner Seite: unser Senior Performance Marketing Manager. Dort liegen Analyse, Attribution und die Aussteuerung der bezahlten Kanäle. Bei dir liegen Marke, Kampagnen und die Kanäle daneben. Ihr arbeitet auf Augenhöhe an einem Funnel.

Founder-Nähe: du arbeitest eng und direkt mit den Gründern an Marke, Botschaft und Ideen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.

Perspektive: Head of Brand mit eigenem Team. Die Bedingung dafür sagen wir dir offen: mindestens ein zusätzlicher skalierbarer Push-Kanal, der uns spürbar schneller wachsen lässt.

Start: so bald wie möglich


Deine Rolle in unserem Team

Du bist die erste Person bei marta, die ausschließlich für die Marke da ist. 8 von 10 unserer treuesten Familien würden marta weiterempfehlen. Diese Geschichte erzählt bisher niemand systematisch. Du gibst marta eine Stimme, ein Gesicht und Kampagnen, die hängen bleiben. Was du jetzt festlegst, ist das Fundament für alles, was danach kommt.

Was du machst

  • Kampagnen, die hängen bleiben. Du entwickelst Kampagnen für Familien, die vor einer der schwersten Entscheidungen ihres Lebens stehen. Keine Werbeanzeigen, sondern etwas, das man sich merkt. Und du bringst sie bis zum fertigen Material.
  • Kanäle planen und koordinieren. Du entscheidest mit, was wir als Nächstes testen, in welcher Reihenfolge und mit welchem Erfolgskriterium. Und du sagst genauso klar, was wir uns sparen, weil du Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Kanälen mitbringst.
  • Texte, die du selbst schreibst. Landingpages, SEO- und Ratgeber-Content, Anzeigentexte, E-Mails, Videoskripte, Social, Print. Am Anfang entstehen sie an deinem Schreibtisch, zunehmend KI-gestützt. Wenn ein Kanal skaliert und wir echtes Volumen brauchen, holen wir Unterstützung dazu. 
  • Produktion briefen. Für Film, Design und größere Produktionen arbeitest du mit Freelancern und Spezialisten. Du briefst sie, beurteilst, was zurückkommt, und hältst die Marke über alle Kanäle konsistent.
  • Social Media, UGC und Community. Hinter marta steht eine große Community aus Betreuungskräften. Daraus machst du Formate, Geschichten und nutzergenerierte Inhalte. Unser Ziel: der größte Pflegekanal Deutschlands. 
  • PR und Presse. Du arbeitest mit einer PR-Agentur, schreibst Pressemitteilungen und baust Regionalpresse als Kanal auf.
  • CRM und Lifecycle. Die Entscheidung für eine 24-Stunden-Betreuung zieht sich über Wochen. Willkommensstrecken, Reaktivierung, WhatsApp: die richtige Botschaft zum richtigen Zeitpunkt statt nur Bottom of Funnel. Die Strecken füllst du mit dem richtigen Content und hast ein Auge dafür was funktioniert und was nicht.
  • Botschaft und Tonalität. Du übersetzt unsere fünf Personas in konkrete Botschaften und Touchpoints. Familien entscheiden emotional und nach Qualität, nicht nach Preis. Dein Text muss das treffen.

Dazu kommen die Themen, die du als Erstes in die Hand nimmst: Bewertungen und Google Business Profile, eine Mechanik für Empfehlungen, Regionalpresse und die Sichtbarkeit von marta in der KI-Suche.


So sieht Erfolg aus
Nach 90 Tagen: die erste CRM-Strecke ist live, zwei Kanäle sind erfolgreich angetestet, die ersten Ergebnisse sind vielversprechend, und wir gehen in die Skalierung.
Nach 6 Monaten: die Markenbotschaft steht und ist an allen Kontaktpunkten sichtbar, zwei bis drei eigene Kampagnen sind live, und das Performance-Marketing arbeitet mit frischem Material statt mit denselben drei Anzeigen.
Nach 12 Monaten: marta hat eine Kampagne, die Familien wiedererkennen, der YouTube-Kanal wächst und liefert Material, das in anderen Kanälen weiterläuft, Branded und Direct Traffic steigen, und neue Quellen liefern verlässlich mehr als 3.000 zusätzliche Leads pro Monat..


Das bringst du zu uns mit

Auf diese fünf Punkte schauen wir. Alles danach ist ein Plus und kein Filter.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre in Marke, Kampagnen oder Content. Agentur oder inhouse, beides passt. Die Jahre sind nicht das Kriterium, die Arbeiten sind es.
  • Arbeiten, die du selbst gemacht hast, nicht nur verantwortet: Texte, Kampagnen, Videos, Seiten. Zwei bis drei davon würden wir gern sehen.
  • Du schreibst sehr gut auf Deutsch (muttersprachliches Niveau, C2) und kannst eine Idee so aufschreiben, dass andere sie umsetzen können.
  • Du hast mindestens einen Kanal außerhalb von Paid Search aufgebaut oder getestet: Mailing, Print, Partnerschaften, Events, Podcast oder TV. Du legst Erfolgskriterien vorher fest und brichst auch mal ab.
  • Du hast mit externen Dienstleistern gearbeitet: auswählen, briefen, Budget führen, Qualität beurteilen.

Das hilft zusätzlich
  • Du hast selbst einmal einen Social-Media-Account aufgebaut und zum Laufen gebracht, beruflich oder privat.
  • Du hast eine Marke mitgestaltet und weißt, wie aus Farben, Designelementen und Sprache ein stimmiges Bild wird.
  • Erfahrung in CRM und Lifecycle (HubSpot, Klaviyo, Superchat oder Vergleichbares).
  • Video und Social sind dir nicht fremd. Du erkennst ein Format, das trägt, und bekommst es auch mit kleinen Mitteln umgesetzt.
  • Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Content-Produktion und ein klares Urteil, wo sie trägt und wo nicht.
  • Erfahrung mit erklärungsbedürftigen, emotionalen Entscheidungen. Lead-Gen statt reinem E-Commerce.
  • Erfahrung im Verhandeln von Media-, Sponsoring- oder Produktionsbudgets.
  • Englisch C1 für die Zusammenarbeit im Team.
  • Wenn du bei ein oder zwei Punkten unsicher bist: bewirb dich und schreib uns, wie du dir das aneignen würdest. Wir entscheiden nach deinen Erfahrungen und unserem Gespräch, nicht nach einer Checkliste.
Diese Rolle passt nicht, wenn
  • du mit einem Rebranding anfangen willst. Logo und Farben sind nicht unser Engpass. Der Engpass sind Kampagnen und Kanäle.
  • du konzipieren, aber nicht schreiben willst. Am Anfang entstehen die Texte an deinem Schreibtisch.
  • du am liebsten in einer Disziplin bleibst. Dein Feld reicht von der Mailing-Strecke bis zum Gespräch mit einem Sender.
  • du Kreation nach Geschmack beurteilst statt nach Wirkung.
  • du lange Abstimmungsschleifen brauchst. Die Wege sind kurz, dafür entsteht viel in kurzer Zeit.


Warum marta?

  • Virtuelle Unternehmensanteile (VSOP nach Jahr 1) und Performance-Bonus
  • 27 Urlaubstage

  • Wellhub (Gympass): Zugang zu Fitness, Studios und Wellbeing
  • Ein internationales Team mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen in Berlin, Bonn, Sibiu und Danzig
  • Unser Prozess
  • Fachgespräch, kurze Kampagnenaufgabe, Kennenlernen mit den Gründern, Reference Calls. Wer im Prozess sitzt, sagen wir dir vorher. Entscheidung in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Wochen.

Deine Bewerbung
Schick uns zwei bis drei Projekte, auf die du stolz bist, und in zwei Sätzen, warum. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Schick alles an Wir stehen für Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung oder Lebensweg. Longer term, you push the KPIs that matter and build retention measures that keep players around. You also shape a team structure that can scale with us. That also means preparing and presenting marketing reporting and KPIs at Group and shareholder level. And you run and assess customer surveys, turning what you learn into decisions we actually act on.

Gaming is a volatile business, and the classic playbook does not always deliver a straight line to growth. We are all pulling for the same outcome for the wider group, which sometimes means short-term compromises we make together. In practice, that also means staying flexible and genuinely meeting people face to face rather than just online.


What convinces us

  • fluent German and English

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The product you will work on

The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. 


Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform.


The ideal candidate is

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production.


This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field.


Your role and responsibilities

You will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams.


Build the platform

  • Architect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters.

  • Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions.

  • Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment.

  • Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations.

  • Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services.

  • Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior

  • .

Run what you build

  • Own the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. All of it is infrastructure as code.

  • Operate and evolve the on-premises Kubernetes footprint at venues, including air-gapped and intermittently connected installations.

  • Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code.

  • Be part of a compensated on-call rotation


Set the technical direction

  • Advise and collaborate with product teams on building distributed systems that are scalable, secure, and observable, and review their designs with production reality in mind.

  • Research and introduce tools and technologies where they measurably improve how we build and operate.

  • Contribute back to the open-source projects we depend on, through issues and fixes.


What you need to succeed in this role

  • Several years of professional software engineering experience, most of it spent designing and shipping production systems.

  • Fluency in software engineering as a craft: concurrency, error handling, testing, and designing APIs that other teams build on.

  • Working knowledge of the Kubernetes control plane and the operator/controller pattern, including how clusters behave when they are unhealthy.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS, and a firm belief in infrastructure as code. Terraform and Ansible are what we use today.

  • Comfort across several languages, and the ability to pick up a new one when the problem calls for it. Our platform work is mostly Go and Python, with Rust and C++ elsewhere in the stack.

  • Experience building distributed systems, and a clear understanding of how they fail: partitions, partial rollouts, clock skew, retries, and reconciliation.

  • A good sense for software architecture and maintainability, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can pick up and change.

  • A strong command of Linux, scripting, and automation.

  • Experience instrumenting software for telemetry and using it to answer real questions about running systems.

  • Good judgment about what to automate and what to leave alone.

  • Strong communication skills in English. You can explain a design or a failure clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists.

  • Willingness to take part in compensated on-call and weekend work when installations need it.

  • A can-do mentality, an eye for detail, and the courage to take on problems outside your comfort zone.

  • Experience in using AI for engineering.


Nice to haves

  • Experience with NATS, Prometheus/Thanos, or PostgreSQL in production.

  • Experience with air-gapped or intermittently connected installations.

  • Experience running Kubernetes in production, not only deploying to it.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, device fleet management, or IoT security.

  • Networking depth: multicast at scale, WireGuard, BGP, IPv6.

  • Experience in the audio, broadcast, or live events industry.

  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects


We offer you

At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.

You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching.

Wir sind Kaan AI, ein KI-Produkt-Lab aus Nürnberg. Wir bauen und vermarkten unsere eigenen Produkte IntelliSchreiber und KalemiFlow, die zehntausende Studierende nutzen.

In nur zwei Monaten haben wir eines der größten UGC-Teams Deutschlands aufgebaut, heute mit 30 Creatorn. Jetzt starten wir in den USA: zuerst mit 10 Creatorn, dann wachsen wir auf 50.

Du übernimmst das komplette UGC-Team, von Scripts bis Coaching, und verantwortest seine Ergebnisse. Du führst unsere Creator in Deutschland und baust das US-Team mit auf. Du zeigst es vor, statt es nur zu erklären, und stehst deshalb auch selbst vor der Kamera.

Wir starten mit 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche, je nachdem, was für dich passt. Nach 3 Monaten ist die Aufstockung auf Vollzeit geplant.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst unser Creator-Team in Deutschland und den USA: Wochenplanung, Output, Qualität
  • Du entwickelst Hooks, Scripts und Formate und baust eine Bibliothek aus dem, was nachweislich performt
  • Du testest neue Ideen über viele Creator gleichzeitig und entscheidest anhand von Views, Retention und Conversions
  • Du coachst jede einzelne Person im Team, bis ihre Videos performen
  • Du drehst neue Formate zuerst selbst, bevor das Team sie übernimmt
  • Du baust das US-Team von 10 auf 50 Creator mit auf: finden, testen, onboarden
  • Du analysierst, was die besten UGC-Teams und Wettbewerber machen, auch mit unseren eigenen KI-Tools

Qualifikation

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge mit Short-Form-Content: eigene oder betreute Videos mit echter Reichweite
  • Erfahrung im Creator-Management, in einer UGC- oder Social-Agentur oder im Social-Team einer Brand
  • Du stehst gern vor der Kamera und kannst Videos drehen, die funktionieren
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen aus Daten und erkennst in Sekunden, warum ein Video floppt
  • Du kannst Menschen führen und motivieren und gibst klares, direktes Feedback
  • Du arbeitest schnell, nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich und denkst trotzdem selbst
  • Fließendes Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch. Wegen der US-Zeitzonen liegen einzelne Calls am Abend
  • Wohnsitz in Deutschland
  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit dem US-Markt oder mit Studierenden als Zielgruppe

Benefits

  • Ownership: Du verantwortest eines der größten UGC-Teams Deutschlands und den Aufbau in den USA
  • Vollzeit nach 3 Monaten geplant
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründer, schnelle Entscheidungen, keine Abstimmungsschleifen
  • Remote-first: Wir stellen Leute ein, denen wir vertrauen. Arbeite von zu Hause, in unserem Büro im Nürnberger Osten (zehn Minuten vom Hauptbahnhof) oder unterwegs auf Reisen. Wo und wann du arbeitest, ist uns egal, solange die Ergebnisse stimmen
  • Du arbeitest für unsere eigenen KI-Produkte mit zehntausenden Nutzern, nicht für Kunden
  • Festgehalt plus Bonus, der mit der Performance wächst, die du in unser Team bringst. Auf Vollzeit gerechnet sind das je nach Performance 3.000 bis 8.000 € brutto im Monat
  • MacBook, iPhone und alles, was du zum Drehen brauchst
  • 30 € monatlicher Zuschuss für Fitness und Gesundheit
  • Essenszuschuss an den Tagen, an denen du bei uns im Büro in Nürnberg arbeitest
  • Optional nach der Probezeit: ein Firmenwagen per Gehaltsumwandlung, den wir mit 300 € im Monat bezuschussen

So arbeiten wir

Tempo. In allem. Wir arbeiten schnell, entscheiden schnell und liefern schnell. Was andere Teams in Wochen schaffen, machen wir in Tagen. Lieber heute eine gute Entscheidung als nächste Woche eine perfekte. Genau dieses Tempo erwarten wir von dir.

Ownership: Du denkst, die KI hilft. Wir nutzen KI überall, wo sie uns schneller macht. Wir suchen aber niemanden, der Aufgaben in ChatGPT kopiert und hofft, dass schon etwas Gutes rauskommt. Du denkst selbst, hinterfragst Ergebnisse und treibst dein Thema bis zum Ergebnis. Die KI ist dein Werkzeug, am Steuer sitzt du.

Wir gewinnen durch Tests. Wir schauen genau hin, was die besten UGC-Teams machen, und lernen daraus. Am Ende entscheidet aber nicht das Bauchgefühl, sondern der Test: Idee, schnell raus, messen, behalten, was funktioniert. Wer mehr und schneller testet, gewinnt.

Laut statt brav. Unser Marketing ist frech, zugespitzt und auch mal reißerisch. Wir brechen die ungeschriebenen Regeln, an die sich andere in der Branche halten, und gehen weiter als die anderen. Das musst du mögen und auf unserem Level mitspielen, auch vor der Kamera.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder, noch besser, ein paar Links zu Videos von dir, die richtig gut performt haben. Nach einem kurzen Gespräch arbeitest du eine Woche bezahlt bei uns mit. So sehen beide Seiten schnell, ob es passt.

About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Team

Our Corporate teams support the company's performance and growth whilst putting people at the core of everything they do. As a French tech leader and global successful company, our Corporate teams are constantly looking for ways to innovate and increase organisation efficiency to keep Voodoo ahead of the market. Voodoo's Corporate function is composed of three teams: HR, Legal and Finance, working together to drive Voodoo's success.

As Voodoo continues to grow, we are transforming the way Finance uses data and technology. Our ambition is to move from fragmented, spreadsheet-heavy workflows to a modern, reliable, and increasingly automated Finance data platform.

 

Role

We're looking for a Finance Data Engineer to join our Corporate team. In this role, you'll own the technical transformation of Finance by building the data foundations, pipelines, and internal tools that enable Finance teams to operate more efficiently and make better decisions.

Reporting to the CFO, you will work closely with Finance stakeholders and Voodoo's central Data team, combining data engineering, business understanding, and product thinking to turn complex Finance needs into reliable and maintainable solutions.

  • Define and drive the roadmap for Finance data, automation, and internal tooling

  • Build and progressively scale Voodoo's Finance data platform, prioritising the use cases that create the greatest business value

  • Migrate critical data transformations and workflows from spreadsheets and legacy tools to tested, documented, code-based solutions

  • Create reliable data models and pipelines for Finance reporting, analysis, forecasting, and operational processes

  • Establish strong standards for data quality, observability, documentation, security, and access management

  • Partner closely with Accounting, FP&A, Controlling, Treasury, and other Finance stakeholders to translate their needs into scalable technical solutions

  • Collaborate regularly with Voodoo's Data leadership and engineering teams to align on architecture, tooling, and best practices

  • Build intuitive dashboards and internal applications that allow Finance teams to explore data and manage workflows independently

  • Identify AI and automation opportunities, take them from prototype to production, and measure the value they create

  • Help Finance teams adopt data and AI tools effectively through documentation, training, and day-to-day support

 

Profile

  • Significant experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role, including ownership of production-grade data solutions

  • Proven track record of building or substantially improving a modern data platform or analytics stack

  • Highly proficient in SQL and comfortable building production systems in Python

  • Strong software-engineering practices applied to data work: testing, version control, code review, documentation, and monitoring

  • Solid understanding of core corporate Finance and accounting concepts; familiarity with French accounting principles is a strong advantage

  • Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear, pragmatic technical solutions

  • Comfortable working autonomously, prioritising competing needs, and delivering value incrementally

Your Role

We're not just looking for someone who can write lines of code; we're seeking an individual who can think beyond code and question the "why" and "how" behind our software engineering processes while understanding the importance of our connection to our customers. As a Firmware Engineer (m/f/d) at STABL Energy, you will drive innovation, solve complex challenges, and contribute to the success of our groundbreaking projects.

Your mission

  • Design, implement, and test firmware for our cutting-edge power electronics products.
  • Continue to implement new ways of assuring firmware quality.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project requirements and objectives, with a keen focus on meeting and exceeding customer expectations.
  • Evaluate and optimize existing firmware code to enhance performance, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Promote best practices in software engineering, emphasizing the importance of a holistic approach beyond just coding and its direct impact on customer satisfaction.

Your profile

  • 4+ years of experience in firmware development for power electronics or other embedded systems.
  • Comprehensive skills in the C programming language, in particular for embedded devices.
  • Expertise on guiding firmware projects to professional standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically about software design and architecture.

  • Excellent English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and translate customer needs into technical solutions.

jobs.description:
Are you prepared to fuel the growth of an exciting scale-up that's transforming the logistics industry? Do you thrive on building strategic relationships and close deals? If so, we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Logistics? Maybe not what you dreamed of as a kid. But building a fast-growing international SaaS scale-up that’s transforming how some of the world’s largest industrial companies operate? That’s a different story.

 

Peripass is a tech company at heart. We build software that digitises and automates complex logistics environments for companies like Bridgestone, Alpro and Arcelor Mittal. These companies have hundreds of trucks (un)loading every month, and our SaaS platform helps them orchestrate that whole process. Peripass is a high-impact SaaS platform used in international enterprise environments.

Want to be part of this adventure? As an Account Executive France within the Sales Team:

  • Launch new product offer: you are mainly responsible for selling remote our newest product in the French market.

  • Pipeline Creation and Management: Independently build and manage a robust sales pipeline with full-cycle ownership, from lead generation to closing. This includes identifying prospects, qualifying leads, and developing opportunities.

  • Active Prospecting and Market Expansion: Engage in targeted outreach to win new customers ("logos") across four different industries, leveraging a strategic and personalized approach.

  • Pipeline Momentum and Sales Velocity: Proactively collaborate with internal stakeholders and customer champions to maintain momentum, reduce sales cycles, and improve win rates. This involves consistent follow-ups, addressing blockers, and aligning on goals.

  • Engagement and Time Savings Case Development: Conduct virtual meetings with prospects in your designated market. Work closely with technical pre-sales teams to co-develop compelling business cases that align with the customer’s objectives and expectations.

  • Deal Negotiation and Closing: Take commercial leadership in deal negotiation and closure, ensuring alignment with the prospect’s needs while achieving company revenue and margin goals. This includes handling objections and finalizing contracts.

  • About every 6 weeks, you'll come and check up on how your colleagues are doing in the Ghent HQ. To get you fully acquainted with your colleagues, you'll also get an in-depth onboarding at our HQ during your first 2 weeks

  • Steven, our Sales Director has already been around the block in SaaS sales. You'll report directly to him and he's looking forward to coaching you extensively, so you can make your career at Peripass a real success story.


What we offer:

  • Win big in a booming market  => Be part of a fast-scaling SaaS company revolutionizing yard management in logistics. Huge potential, untapped opportunities, and the chance to make a real impact in France.

  • Uncapped earning potential => A competitive salary with a commission plan that truly rewards success. The more you close, the more you earn.

  • Ownership & freedom => Take charge of your pipeline and strategy. We trust you to drive results, with the flexibility to work how and where you perform best.

  • Backed by a winning team => From marketing to pre-sales and customer success, you’ll have a strong team behind you, helping you close and grow accounts.


What you’ll bring:

  • A solid experience in selling enterprise SaaS solutions. 

  • Ideally you have experience in the Logistics & Supply Chain sector.  

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills. 

  • Strong stakeholder management to manage complex DMU's and land sales processes in international corporate environments.

  • A partnership and win-win mindset while selling our solution.

  • A great sense of initiative and perseverance, since you'll be opening up a new market. 

  • You speak and write French on a native level. You can have a professional conversation in English since that is our internal language.

jobs.description:
🎯 Ton objectif :

Piloter l'ensemble du périmètre Marketing et eCommerce d'un pure-player des vins et spiritueux sur 7 marchés européens : assurer la continuité des opérations et piloter les chantiers prioritaires 2027.

En 5 hashtags, ça donne 👉 #Ecommerce #P&L #Roadmap #Management #International

🍒 sur le 🎂 : un périmètre complet et rare, avec 25 personnes et zéro agence externe. Tout est piloté en interne, y compris les développements du site.

🚀 Tes missions principales :

  • Piloter l'ensemble des pôles marketing et eCommerce sur 7 marchés européens : Paid Media, SEO/GEO, eMerch, Animation Coommerciale, CRM, UX/IU, Studio créa, Réseaux sociaux et Service client.

  • Manager une équipe de 25 collaborateurs, structurée autour de leads de pôle autonomes qui attendent un encadrement fort.

  • Assurer la continuité des opérations dès ta prise de poste, sans temps mort.

  • Piloter les chantiers prioritaires pour 2027.

  • Arbitrer la roadmap et le backlog du site eCommerce avec les équipes de développement internes.

💛 Ton équipe :

L'entreprise : un acteur du eCommerce implanté à Annecy, qui gère tout en interne, du trafic au SEO, jusqu'aux développements du site.

Ton équipe : 25 collaborateurs, répartis sur 5 pôles avec un lead ou un·e responsable sur chacun. Des leads globalement autonomes, mais une équipe en attente d'un vrai cap.

Ton manager : le Directeur Général de l’entreprise, entré dans l’entreprise il y a 20 ans et ayant occupé des fonctions commerciales puis de direction générale.

Tes interlocuteurs : les leads de chaque pôle et les équipes techniques internes, qui développent le site sur un back-office entièrement personnalisé.

💻 Tes Conditions de travail :

  • 📍 Ton bureau : sur Annecy, accessible en transports en commun, depuis la gare SNCF.

  • 📑 Ton contrat :

    • Statut :

      • CDD de 7 mois minimum, potentiellement renouvelable.

      • Possibilité de mission en management de transition

      • Possibilité de temps partiel (au moins 3 jours par semaine sur place)

    • Salaire : de 75 à 90k€ bruts annuels pour un temps plein, payés sur 12 mois.

    • Prime de précarité de 10% en fin de contrat.

    • Participation annuelle aux résultats.

    • Autres avantages : tickets restaurant pris en charge à 50%, forfait mobilité durable de 25€ par mois si tu viens en vélo ou en moyen de mobilité douce.

  • 🚲 Ton rythme :

    • 100% présentiel les 3 premiers mois

    • 1 jour de télétravail maximum par semaine après 3 mois.

  • ⚠️ Prise de poste : au plus vite, début novembre au plus tard.


Tes expériences & compétences :

  • Tu as au moins 15 ans d'expérience post-études en eCommerce B2C, dont au moins 8 ans en tant que Manager sur un périmètre international, idéalement avec une expérience chez un pure player.

  • Tu as déjà managé hiérarchiquement plus de 10 collaborateurs en CDI.

  • Tu as déjà été en charge d'un P&L eCommerce supérieur à 15M€/an.

  • Tu as déjà managé et fait évoluer l'ensemble des pôles marketing : Trafic, SEO, CRM, Régie, UX et Studio créa. Chacun de ces sujets, tu l'as pratiqué, pas seulement supervisé de loin.

  • Tu sais arbitrer une roadmap et un backlog produit avec des équipes de développement internes.

  • Tu es à l’aise en anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, idéalement avec un niveau C1.

  • Tu es basé·e dans la région d'Annecy, ou prêt·e à t'y installer (pas de télétravail sur les 3 premiers mois, puis un seul par semaine maximum).

Ta personnalité :

  • Autonome et opérationnel·le, tu prends la main vite : ici, la continuité des opérations se joue dès les premiers jours.

  • Manager dans l'âme, tu sais donner un cap à des leads déjà expérimentés et autonomes, qui attendent surtout d'être encadré·es et embarqué·es.

C'est un périmètre rare : tout le marketing et tout le eCommerce, en interne, sans agence, avec 25 personnes et des leads solides sur chaque pôle. Le poste s'adresse à quelqu'un qui a déjà mis les mains dans chacun de ces sujets et qui sait prendre un relais sans temps de latence. jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Kernel & Inference Optimization)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Kernel & Inference Optimization) based in France.

You will work at the intersection of AI research, systems engineering, and high-performance model inference.
Your focus will be on developing and optimizing model-serving architectures for advanced AI systems across a range of hardware environments.
You will tackle challenges involving latency, throughput, memory efficiency, and scalability, including deployment on resource-constrained mobile and edge devices.
The role combines hands-on research with low-level engineering, giving you the opportunity to develop novel inference strategies and GPU kernels.
You will work with complex architectures spanning text, image, audio, diffusion models, and vision transformers.
Your work will involve rigorous benchmarking, production testing, and iterative optimization to translate research into measurable performance improvements.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams in a highly technical, remote environment focused on pushing the boundaries of efficient AI systems.


Accountabilities
  • Design and deploy advanced model-serving architectures optimized for high throughput, low latency, and efficient memory utilization.
  • Develop inference pipelines capable of operating effectively across diverse environments, including resource-constrained mobile devices and edge platforms.
  • Establish clear performance targets covering response latency, token generation speed, throughput, memory footprint, and reliability.
  • Build and execute controlled inference benchmarks in simulated and production environments, tracking latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates.
  • Create and maintain representative datasets and simulation scenarios for evaluating model performance under real-world and resource-constrained conditions.
  • Identify computational and memory bottlenecks across inference pipelines and implement solutions involving batching, networking, memory management, and other system-level optimizations.
  • Develop custom GPU kernels and compute shaders for mobile hardware, including solutions written in Metal Shading Language (MSL).
  • Apply advanced inference optimization techniques such as pruning, quantization, Flash Attention, KV caching, and speculative decoding.
  • Design and optimize distributed inference systems using approaches such as tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and expert parallelism for large-scale GPU workloads.
  • Work with cross-functional engineering and research teams to integrate optimized inference frameworks into production and edge-device applications.
  • Define evaluation methodologies, document experimental results, compare performance against established benchmarks, and continuously refine optimization strategies.
  • Monitor production performance and use empirical research to identify opportunities for further improvements in scalability, efficiency, and reliability.

    • Requirements:

    • Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; a PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related discipline is highly relevant, particularly with a strong AI research track record and publications at leading conferences.
    • Proven expertise in Metal Shading Language (MSL), including the ability to write custom compute shaders from scratch.
    • Demonstrated experience with low-level kernel optimization and inference optimization on mobile or other resource-constrained devices.
    • Track record of delivering measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications.
    • Deep understanding of modern model-serving architectures, inference engines, and optimization techniques for high-performance AI deployment.
    • Strong experience writing GPU kernels for mobile devices such as smartphones.
    • Practical experience developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from model optimization through production integration on constrained hardware.
    • Strong ability to apply empirical research and systematic experimentation to solve latency, computational, and memory challenges.
    • Experience designing robust evaluation and benchmarking frameworks for inference systems.
    • Knowledge of distributed inference techniques, including tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and expert parallelism for large-scale GPU clusters.
    • Deep understanding of the mathematical foundations and architecture of diffusion models and Vision Transformers.
    • Familiarity with modern inference optimization techniques including pruning, quantization, Flash Attention, KV Cache optimization, and speculative decoding such as EAGLE.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with an ability to investigate complex system bottlenecks and turn research findings into practical engineering solutions.
    • Excellent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed, cross-functional technical teams.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work on advanced AI systems spanning model serving, inference optimization, mobile computing, edge deployment, and large-scale distributed inference.
      • Remote-first working environment with an international team.
      • Exposure to cutting-edge AI research and practical systems engineering challenges.
      • Opportunity to contribute to performance-critical infrastructure where improvements can have a measurable impact on real-world AI applications.
      • Collaborative environment combining research-driven experimentation with hands-on engineering.
      • Opportunity to work with advanced model architectures including diffusion models, Vision Transformers, and multimodal systems.
      • Access to challenging technical problems involving GPU kernels, inference engines, memory optimization, and distributed computing.

jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de transformer la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses. Chez Deliveroo, impact, innovation et croissance sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les livreurs partenaires pour donner à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elle veut, comme elle le veut, quand elle le veut et où elle le veut.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d'un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

  • Commercial : vous avez à cœur de négocier, d'anticiper des discussions commerciales, d'entreprendre des actions afin de maintenir un portefeuille de qualité (discussions contractuelles, négociations de mise en place d'outils commerciaux, etc)

  • Centré sur le client : être obsédé par nos clients. Utiliser des données quantitatives et qualitatives pour construire un service qui soit opérationnellement excellent pour nos clients.

  • Jouer en équipe : un joueur d'équipe qui collabore et qui est capable de tirer le meilleur parti des personnes qui vous entourent. Capable de travailler efficacement à tous les niveaux de Deliveroo et de réussir avec et par les autres.

  • Optimiste, confiant et plein d'énergie : vous apportez de la fraîcheur, de l'énergie et de la passion dans l'équipe. Vous contribuez à créer un environnement de travail unique, propice aux nouvelles idées et agréable pour les autres personnes impliquées.

Nous sommes des passionnés de food, des problem-solvers, des créateurs de communauté et bien plus encore. Ce qui nous rassemble : un esprit entrepreneurial fort et l'envie de construire quelque chose d'ambitieux ensemble.
